name: opencode-remote
description: Remote opencode serve client for VS Code

opencode.remote.username.description: HTTP Basic Auth username for remote opencode serve.

opencode.remote.defaultModel.description: Optional default model in provider/model format.

opencode.remote.defaultAgent.description: Optional default agent name for chat requests when local-only mode is disabled.

opencode.remote.localOnlyAgent.description: Required VS Code local agent name for chat and inline completion. Configure this agent on the remote OpenCode server with server filesystem tools denied.

opencode.remote.context.maxFileBytes.description: Maximum text bytes to include per local file context.

opencode.remote.context.maxFiles.description: Maximum number of local files to include in one request.

opencode.remote.context.includeDiagnosti.description: Include VS Code diagnostics in chat context by default.

opencode.remote.context.includeGitDiff.description: Include git diff in chat context by default.

opencode.remote.context.localOnlyMode.description: Prefer VS Code supplied local context and warn/block file questions when no local file content was captured.

opencode.remote.context.strictLocalOnlyA.description: Legacy compatibility setting. Local-only mode now always sends opencode.remote.localOnlyAgent and fails closed if that agent is unavailable.

opencode.remote.completion.provider.description: Provider for inline completions. OpenCode uses the remote opencode serve session; OpenAI-compatible calls a direct model API for completion only.

opencode.remote.completion.profile.description: Direct model completion profile. Generic Chat uses /chat/completions; Qwen Coder FIM uses raw /completions with Qwen fill-in-the-middle tokens.

opencode.remote.completion.apiBaseUrl.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL for direct inline completions, for example http://localhost:8000/v1.

opencode.remote.completion.model.description: Optional direct inline completion model. Falls back to opencode.remote.defaultModel when empty.

opencode.remote.completion.maxTokens.description: Maximum generated tokens for direct inline completions.

opencode.remote.completion.topP.description: Top-p nucleus sampling value for direct inline completions.

opencode.remote.completion.debounceMs.description: Debounce time before requesting inline completions.

opencode.remote.completion.logLevel.description: Output logging level for remote OpenCode inline completions.

opencode.remote.codeGraph.enabled.description: Automatically enable local C/C++ code graph indexing. The index stays local and only query-relevant context is sent to remote OpenCode.

opencode.remote.codeGraph.promptOnWorksp.description: Legacy prompt setting retained for existing profiles; code graph now auto-indexes when enabled.

opencode.remote.codeGraph.analysisMode.description: Local code graph analysis mode. Auto uses the bundled Tree-sitter WASM analyzer when available; semantic is reserved for compile database backed analysis.

opencode.remote.codeGraph.maxFiles.description: Maximum number of C/C++ files to index in the local code graph.

opencode.remote.codeGraph.maxContextByte.description: Maximum bytes of local code graph context to include in one remote prompt.

opencode.remote.codeGraph.maxEvidenceByt.description: Maximum bytes of retrieved local code evidence to include in one remote prompt.

opencode.remote.codeGraph.maxGraphDepth.description: Maximum caller/callee graph depth for local code graph retrieval.

opencode.remote.codeGraph.maxFanout.description: Maximum relation fanout per graph expansion step for local code graph retrieval.

opencode.remote.codeGraph.maxDeepFiles.description: Maximum candidate files to inspect in a future deep local code graph analysis pass.

opencode.remote.codeGraph.maxStateTransi.description: Maximum state transitions to include in a future local state-machine evidence pass.

opencode.remote.codeGraph.watcherRescanT.description: Number of queued file watcher events that switches incremental indexing to one scheduled full rescan.

opencode.remote.codeGraph.workerConcurre.description: Target concurrency for local analysis worker batches and benchmark planning.

opencode.remote.codeGraph.queryCacheSize.description: Maximum number of hot local code graph query contexts to keep in memory.

opencode.remote.codeGraph.memoryLimitMb.description: Soft heap limit for local code graph indexing. When exceeded, the service reports degraded mode and trims hot caches.

opencode.remote.codeGraph.compileCommand.description: Optional path to compile_commands.json for future semantic C/C++ code graph analysis. Relative paths are resolved from the workspace root.

opencode.remote.codeGraph.clangdPath.description: Optional path to clangd on the workspace host for future semantic C/C++ code graph analysis.

opencode.remote.codeGraph.scipClangPath.description: Optional path to scip-clang on the workspace host for future semantic C/C++ code graph analysis.

opencode.remote.codeGraph.excludeGlobs.description: Additional VS Code glob patterns to exclude from local code graph indexing.

opencode.remote.analysis.bridge.enabled.description: Start a localhost-only Analysis Tool Bridge and generate a .opencode custom tool that lets OpenCode query the local index.

opencode.remote.analysis.maxEvidenceItem.description: Maximum evidence item count returned by local analysis tools.

opencode.remote.analysis.maxEvidenceByte.description: Maximum evidence bytes returned by local analysis tools and evidence packs.

opencode.remote.analysis.maxFileSliceByt.description: Maximum bytes returned from one local file slice analysis call.

opencode.remote.analysis.maxGraphEdges.description: Maximum graph edges returned by local callers, callees, call-chain, and state-machine analysis.

opencode.remote.analysis.maxPaths.description: Maximum state-machine or call-chain paths returned by local analysis tools.

opencode.remote.rag.embedding.endpoint.description: Full localhost or intranet embedding endpoint. OpenAI-compatible /v1/embeddings responses are expected. RAG vector retrieval is enabled automatically when this endpoint is configured and reachable.

opencode.remote.rag.embedding.model.description: Embedding model name sent to the local or intranet embedding endpoint.

opencode.remote.rag.embedding.batchSize.description: Number of RAG chunks embedded per HTTP request. The request timeout is configured automatically from this value.

opencode.remote.rag.embedding.maxTokensP.description: Estimated maximum embedding tokens sent in one RAG embedding HTTP request. This is a lightweight safety cap for large chunks.

opencode.remote.rag.embedding.concurrent.description: Initial maximum concurrent embedding requests during RAG indexing. The indexer can temporarily lower this under provider pressure and raise it by one after stable success.

opencode.remote.rag.embedding.maxInFligh.description: Approximate maximum embedding input tokens across in-flight RAG embedding requests.

opencode.remote.rag.embedding.encodingFo.description: Embedding response encoding format. Float is most compatible; base64 and auto are used only when the endpoint supports them.

opencode.remote.rag.embedding.checkpoint.description: How often RAG embedding indexing writes recoverable partial checkpoints before the final index save.
Number of newly embedded chunks between partial RAG checkpoint saves when checkpoint mode is interval. Set to 0 to disable chunk-based checkpoints.
Milliseconds between partial RAG checkpoint saves when checkpoint mode is interval. Set to 0 to disable time-based checkpoints.

opencode.remote.rag.embedding.timeoutMs.description: Timeout for one embedding HTTP request. This value is managed automatically from opencode.remote.rag.embedding.batchSize.
opencode.remote.rag.embedding.timeoutMs.deprecationMessage: RAG embedding timeout is managed automatically from batch size: 32/64/128/256 use 30000ms, 512 uses 90000ms.

opencode.remote.rag.embedding.requestDel.description: Optional delay before starting the next RAG embedding HTTP request. Usually 0 when adaptive concurrency is enabled.

opencode.remote.rag.embedding.maxRequest.description: Maximum embedding HTTP requests used by one RAG index run. Set to 0 for unlimited requests.

opencode.remote.rag.embedding.maxRetries.description: Maximum retry attempts for one RAG embedding batch when the provider returns 429 or 503.

opencode.remote.rag.embedding.retryBacko.description: Base exponential backoff delay used when a rate-limited embedding response has no Retry-After header.

opencode.remote.rag.embedding.resumeAuto.description: Automatically resume paused RAG embedding index runs in the background until pending chunks are complete.

opencode.remote.rag.embedding.resumeDela.description: Delay before automatically resuming a paused RAG embedding index run after the per-run request budget is reached.

opencode.remote.rag.rerank.endpoint.description: Full localhost or intranet rerank endpoint accepting query, documents, and top_n. Rerank is enabled automatically when this endpoint is configured and allowed.

opencode.remote.rag.rerank.model.description: Rerank model name sent to the local or intranet rerank endpoint.

opencode.remote.rag.allowedHosts.description: Additional intranet hostnames allowed for embedding and rerank endpoints. Localhost and private IPs are allowed automatically.

opencode.remote.rag.vectorTopK.description: Maximum vector candidates added to each hybrid RAG query.

opencode.remote.rag.rerankTopK.description: Maximum non-strong evidence candidates sent to the optional rerank service.

scripts.compile: bun run check-types && bun run lint && tsc --project tsconfig.json
scripts.package: bun run check-types && bun run lint && tsc --project tsconfig.json
